```php
namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Faker\Factory;

class CategorySeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run()
    {
        $faker = Factory::create();

        for ($i = 1; $i <= 10; $i++) {
            \App\Models\Category::create([
                'name' => $faker->name(),
            ]);
        }
    }
}
```
